name: Mandarin Oriental, Sanya
insider_take: Where tropical luxury meets ancient Chinese philosophy in Hainan's crown jewel destination.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on Coral Bay's pristine coastline, featuring the only overwater villas in mainland China. The property showcases traditional Hainanese architecture with contemporary Oriental elegance, while Sanya itself is known as "China's Hawaii" with year-round tropical weather and duty-free shopping paradise status.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby Nanshan Temple to see the 354-foot Guanyin statue - one of the tallest statues in the world - then return for sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar.
dont_miss: The resort's signature spa treatments using local coconut and sea salt, plus easy access to Yalong Bay's crystal-clear waters. Sanya Bay offers incredible seafood markets, and the nearby Wuzhizhou Island provides world-class diving among coral reefs teeming with tropical fish.
pros: Exceptional beachfront location with pristine white sand beach access
Legendary Mandarin Oriental service standards and attention to detail
Luxurious spa facilities with traditional Asian wellness treatments
Multiple award-winning dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Remote location requires travel time to downtown Sanya attractions
